description: This file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) interface for managing locked apps in a database, using Room persistence library annotations to specify database operations such as querying, inserting, and deleting.

classes.name: LockedAppDao
classes.description: DAO interface for accessing and manipulating data related to locked applications in the database.

methods.name: observeAll
methods.description: Returns a Flow emitting lists of all LockedApp entities from the database.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a LockedApp entity into the database, replacing any existing record with the same primary key.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a specified LockedApp entity from the database.

methods.name: isLocked
methods.description: Checks if a package name is marked as locked in the database.

calls: androidx.room.Query("SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM locked_apps WHERE packageName = :pkg)")
